name: Empowered Ruby
body:
Through almiraj rituals your ruby has grown larger and more powerful.

Prerequisite(s): Magic Ruby, 9th level, magic horn racial trait, Almiraj

Benefit(s): The enhancement bonus of your magic horn is equal to 1 + the level of the highest level spell you can cast (rounded down). Your horn cannot exceed a +5 enhancement bonus.

Normal: Your magic horn has a +1 enhancement.

Example: If you could cast 4th level spells your magic horn would have a +5 enhancement.
